reason_not_formal: The first one-shot benchmark was run before GitHub publication, then the verifier/checksum sources were reformatted for readability. The published source bytes therefore do not equal the pre-freeze SHA-256 set. The benchmark is retained as development evidence but is not promoted as a formal frozen result.
construction_regression: PASS 5/5 on the semantically equivalent pre-publication candidate: good artifact accepted; bad launcher mode, checksum tamper, retained closure omission and support metadata error rejected
claim_boundary: These timings show only that the construction was comfortably sub-5-second on one container. They are not a formal performance claim and are not WSLg setup, GUI, model, network or end-user install timings.
